card.name: Linking words in anesthesia and interaction text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (with, of, from, and, the) or the start of a drug name right after anesthesia, surgery or drug-interaction wording. It fires where a term like general or local anesthesia could plausibly come next.

modes.label: Linker after surgery or anesthesia
modes.description: A word such as with, of, from or and directly after surgery, anesthesia or procedure terms.
modes.example: In patients undergoing major surgery or during anesthesia<< with>> agents that produce hypotension, Z

modes.label: Partway through drug-class lists
modes.description: The start of a drug name inside a list of interacting drugs, such as tricyclic or allopurinol.

card.writes: It pushes toward the words local and general, and away from anesthesia and analysis words.
card.plain: It marks small words in anesthesia and drug-interaction passages where a word like local or general might come next.
